model_annotation: The pie chart above compares the percentages of future engineering graduates who will take part-time management studies and those who will take full-time management studies. The pie chart shows that 51% of the graduates will take full-time management studies, 23% will take part-time management studies, 23% will take general management studies, 3% will take community studies, and 0% will take fine arts studies. In total, 9 out of 11 engineering graduates will take management-related studies. This is in comparison to the 10 engineering graduates who will take part-time studies and the 8 that will take full-time, general, and community studies. The pie chart also shows 1 engineering graduate who will take fine arts studies.
